g.text: Organ Marker Diagnostic: Markers Do Not Separate Organs in Seedling Atlas

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #666666

g.text: Photosynthetic markers (RBCS, FSD1) are ubiquitous across all cell types.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #666666

g.text: Root markers (SCR, PLT1, WOL) are very low (<7%). Seed markers near-zero.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #666666
